Bakker et al., 2012；Kaniewski et al., 2012, 2013 根据各花粉类群所偏好的气候对它们分组，据此提出关于气温乃至广义气候的见解。但这一方法涉及若干方法论问题（如 Luterbacher et al., 2012: 134–139）。其中一个重要问题是，他们在此处检测到的变化，时间恰好是七世纪中叶。除此以外，唯一表明七世纪中叶是安纳托利亚气温转折点的代用指标，是戈尔希萨尔湖的数据，但其年代界定很不可靠。相关批评及更多文献见 Izdebski, Roberts and Waliszewski 2015。

Bakker et al., 2012; Kaniewski et al., 2012, 2013 classified pollen taxa in groups according to their climatic preferences and on this basis made claims about temperature and climate more broadly. But there area number of methodological problems associated with this approach (e.g., Luterbacher et al., 2012: 134–139), not the least of which is that in this case the change they detect coincides with the mid-seventh century. The only other proxy that suggests the mid-seventh century as a turning point in temperature in the Anatolia region is the data from Lake Gölhisar, which has very unreliable chronological definition. See for a critique with further literature Izdebski, Roberts and Waliszewski 2015.

农业与乡村生产
Agriculture and Rural Production

到目前为止，我已经相当详细地考察了东罗马帝国的人如何看待自己的世界。这些看法体现在有关基督教教义与信仰的著述、论战文献、圣徒传及奇迹故事、教会法与世俗法的法律文献，以及史学著作中。在我们的文献及其他遗存所能提供的线索范围内，我也考察了不同社会阶层、处于不同社会和文化环境中的人，怎样回应自己周围的世界。现在该看看七、八世纪拜占庭的物质环境了。这一切活动都发生在一定的物质空间之中。这个环境既约束和限制人的信念与行动，也反过来受到它们的影响。尤其考虑到七世纪东罗马国家及其居民的处境，我们需要说明政府最终从什么产品与财富中取得税收，看看是否曾发生有助于解释帝国存续的重大变化。为此，我们需要知道帝国的乡村生产者种植和收获的是什么，又是在什么条件和情形下生产的。如今我们知道，晚期罗马世界的大尺度气候，以及农业与乡村生产的格局，都曾有过一些重要变化，因此应追问这些变化有何影响（假如确有影响），以及由什么因素造成。前面几章中，我说明了七世纪中叶出现的政治与经济新局面，怎样改变了我们可笼统称为支配性精英或统治精英的各个群体的构成、文化认同和价值观。下一章将说明，同样的情形又如何迫使政府改变管理资源的方式。这一变化并非出自一套明确的举措或改革（虽然此类举措或改革可能也有一些），而是各个层次对不同因素所作出的一系列反应，其结果是一套与以往大不相同的行政机构。我们仍有待做的，是将所有这些社会与政治安排置于其环境背景之中。

So far I have looked in some detail at the ways in which people in the East Roman Empire viewed their world, as reflected in texts about Christian dogma and faith, polemical writings, hagiography and miracle stories, legal texts— both church law and secular law— and historiography. I have also looked at how people at different social levels and in different social and cultural contexts responded, insofar as our texts and other monuments shed light on this, to the world around them. It is now time to take a look at the physical world of seventh- and eighth-century Byzantium because all these activities are inscribed within a physical, spatial context, which itself both constrains or sets limits to beliefs and actions as well as being in turn subject to those beliefs and activities. In particular, and in light of the situation of the eastern Roman state and its inhabitants in the seventh century, we need to account for the products and the wealth from which the government ultimately drew its taxes to see if there were any significant changes that took place that may help to explain the empire’s survival. And in order to do that, we need to understand what the rural producers of the empire were growing and harvesting, and under what conditions and circumstances. Since we now know that there were some important changes in both the broader climate of the late Roman world as well as in patterns of agriculture and rural production, we should inquire what impact, if any, these may have had and what brought them about. In the preceding chapters I showed how the transformed political and economic situation that arose in the middle of the seventh century generated changes in the composition, cultural identity, and values of the various elements that made up what we may refer to broadly as the dominant or ruling elite. In the next chapter I will show how these same circumstances compelled the government to revise the ways through which it managed its resources. This was not a set of specific actions or reforms (although there probably were some of these too) but rather a series of reactions at different levels to different stimuli resulting in a very different administrative apparatus from that which went before. What we have not yet done is to locate all these social and political arrangements in their environmental context.

如第一章所述，到了七世纪中叶，帝国拥有安纳托利亚次大陆约三分之二的土地，以及爱琴海诸岛、巴尔干南部漫长的沿海地带和沿岸背后的部分平原。此外，它还保有盛产谷物的西西里，在撒丁、巴利阿里群岛和意大利南部若干地方还有残存但情形不甚明了的势力，当然也包括意大利东北部疆域有限的所谓拉文纳总督区。直到690年代，帝国仍控制着北非的大部分地区，不过自660年代起，阿拉伯人的袭扰与进攻对这种控制构成越来越大的挑战。根据留存的文献和相关材料，尤其帝国财税官员铅印玺所提供的证据，我们所能判断的是，帝国收入的主要来源是小亚细亚与西西里。如前所见，直到680年代，北非虽居其次，却仍相当重要。这里，我想考察气候、地貌和物产。

As noted in Chapter 1, by the middle of the seventh century the empire consisted of some two-thirds of the Anatolian subcontinent, together with the Aegean Islands and long coastal stretches around the southern Balkan littoral, with some of the plains lying behind them. In addition, it held Sicily, a rich source of grain, with a hazy presence in Sardinia and in the Balearics as well as in parts of southern Italy and, of course, the circumscribed territory of the so-called exarchate of Ravenna in the northeast. Until the 690s it controlled much of North Africa— a control, however, that was increasingly challenged from the 660s by Arab raids and attacks. As far as we can tell from the extant textual and related evidence, especially the testimony of the lead seals of imperial fiscal officials, the main sources of imperial income were Asia Minor and Sicily, with North Africa playing a secondary but still important role into the 680s, as we have now seen. Here I want to look at climate, landscape, and products.

What sort of agrarian economy had generated the revenues of the late Roman state in the east before the changes of the seventh century? The Anatolian plateau, with its steppic climatic environment, is dominated by a largely pastoral and cereal-growing economy and, in spite of the relatively harsh winters and long arid summers, is not unfavorable to cereal production, which depends as much on the seasonal pattern
of rainfall (in this case with a marked spring maximum) as it does on the volume of precipitation.

(See Map 6.1.) In contrast, the coastal plains reflect a Mediterranean or transitional Mediterranean environment where cereals, fruits, and nuts as well as vegetables, olives, and vines flourished. The coastal regions and islands, whether mountainous or consisting of plains and river valleys, all share certain key features that permit them to support a very wide range of agricultural and pastoral activities. All around the Mediterranean as well as inland in the river valleys and less exposed plains, vines, olives, fruits, and cereals were grown while fowl, goats, pigs, cattle, and sheep were raised. The proportions of each of these to one another depended on local terrain and established patterns of land tenure as well as market demand, on the one hand, and the need to sell produce to pay taxes, on the other (Map 6.2).

This agrarian culture involved a mixed regime of cereals, fruit, vegetables, olives and vines, and livestock in different proportions according to local conditions. It is characteristic of the large-scale human environmental impact found across a wide territory stretching from the southern Balkans, through Anatolia, and into the Caucasus and

southwestern Caspian area. Known to historians of the environment as the Beyşehir Occupation Phase (BOP), it reflects a period of anthropogenic activity stretching approximately from 1500 BCE until 800 CE.

From the point of view of archaeologically identifiable cultures it covers the centuries from the Hellenistic through into the early Byzantine period (ca. 300 BCE to ca. 700 CE). It can be shown from the evidence of pollen (found at archaeological sites or in a variety of natural deposits such as lake beds) that the BOP begins and ends in different places at slightly different times. Its final phase stretches from the fifth into the later seventh or early eighth century, depending on site location. At some sites with well-defined timescales, the end of the phase is dated to the middle or later seventh century, while at other sites its termination is set somewhat earlier.
While most clearly evidenced in the upland valleys of southwest Anatolia, where it is characterized by the cultivation of nut trees, cereal growing, and pastoralism,
it is also recorded in pollen diagrams from sites in northwestern Turkey, parts of Greece, and other sites in the eastern Mediterranean.

对于BOP结束的年代，人们之所以有疑问和争论，部分是因为从各组数据推得的年代序列不够精确。这又引出两个问题：各地的地貌巨变究竟同时还是先后发生，又可能出于什么原因？但所有记录都显示，在公元第一千纪中段的某个时候，人类活动的指标急剧下降，松树花粉却有所增加。这些不同的地貌类型、它们适宜生长的各种作物，以及相关地区季节性气温与降水的大致格局，都经过充分研究，各大区域的差异也得到了很好的认识。

The reason for the uncertainty and debate about the end date for the BOP lies partly in the imprecision of the chronologies derived from the various datasets. This raises the questions of whether major landscape change occurred at the same or at different times across different regions and what the causes of such changes may have been. But all the records show a sharp decline in anthropogenic indicators and a rise in pine pollen at some point during the middle of the first millennium CE. These different landscape types, the range of crops they supported, and the general patterns of seasonal temperature and rainfall produced across the areas in question have all been well studied and the broad regional variations are well understood.
气候波动
Climatic Fluctuations
一考虑森林砍伐、侵蚀、冲积、过度开发或放牧的影响、土壤耗竭和土地撂荒等问题，就很清楚，有史以来，人类活动始终是影响地貌的最重要因素之一。不过，人类影响土地的方式，本身又受到某些人力无法控制的因素的影响，气候因素尤为突出。
即便变化很小，在地方上也可能产生重大影响。因此，在考察这对我们所讨论时期的拜占庭国家可能有何意义之前，先极简要地回顾一下，关于从罗马晚期到中世纪这一地区的气候史，我们知道些什么。

That human activity has always been one of the most significant features impacting on the landscape in historical times is a point that is apparent as soon as we consider issues such as deforestation, erosion, alluviation, the impact of overexploitation, overgrazing, soil-exhaustion, and abandonment. But the way people affect the land is itself influenced by certain factors outside human control, particularly climatic factors.

Quite minor shifts can have significant effects at a local level, so before looking at their possible significance for the Byzantine state in the period with which we are concerned, we will review very briefly what is known about the climate history of the region across the later Roman and into the medieval period.
人们普遍同意，古气候记录表明，从公元前三世纪后期
至公元二世纪后期，欧亚大陆西部普遍处于一种相对稳定、温暖和湿润的气候状态，总体上有利于集约农业。这常被称作“罗马暖期”（Roman Warm Period，RWP）。当时的气候风险较低，年代际波动有限，许多历史学家认为这与罗马军事和政治权力的增长、巩固，以及经济扩张有关。这种情势也有利于欧洲中部和北部农业扩展、人口增长。
太阳活动的记录加强了这一认识。人们大体同意，观测所得的古气候记录与太阳活动的变化之间，存在相关关系。太阳活动较弱时，也就是太阳活动极小期，气温较低，活动较强时则气温较高。
有些学者把气候和太阳活动同历史事件或发展联系起来，但二者当然从来不一一对应，许多情形仍有激烈争论。下文谈到我们所论的时期时，将回到这一点。
太阳活动的证据，主要来自某些同位素，尤其是碳-14（放射性碳）和铍-10。已知年代的树木年轮提供了北半球全新世大气中碳-14浓度变化的高分辨率记录，且具有绝对年代。
铍-10的记录主要取自极地冰芯，分辨率可达一年。研究已表明，其变化与太阳黑子活动精确相符，也同碳-14数据给出的绝对年代序列吻合。
重要的是，气候史家可以相当有把握地判断历经几千年的重大气候变化。相比较而言，这些大阶段内部的细小波动，通常远不那么清楚，因为它们受到一系列因素影响，其中很多仍有待充分研究。
It is generally agreed that records for ancient climate indicate that the regime prevailing across western Eurasia from the later third century BCE

into the late second century CE was relatively stable, warm, and moist—in general, conducive to intensive agriculture. This is frequently referred to as the Roman Warm Period (RWP) and was characterized by relatively low-risk conditions with limited decadal variability, associated by many historians with the growth and consolidation of Roman military and political power and economic expansion. Such a situation was also favorable to the expansion of agriculture and population in central and northern Europe.

Records of solar activity reinforce this picture: there is general agreement that a correlation exists between observed paleoclimate records and changing solar activity. Low solar activity— solar minima—is reflected in low temperatures and high solar activity in higher temperatures.

Some scholars have associated climate and solar activity with historical events or developments, although of course this is never a one- to-one relationship and in many cases remains hotly debated— a point to which we will return à propos of our period below.

The solar evidence derives chiefly from certain isotopes, notably C14 (radiocarbon) and 10Be (Beryllium 10). Thus, known-age tree rings offer an absolutely dated and highly resolved record of changing atmospheric C14 levels through the Holocene for the northern hemisphere,

while 10Be records, extracted chiefly from polar ice cores, have annual resolution and have been shown to correspond exactly with sunspot activity, matching also the absolute chronology offered by the C14 data.

The point is that climate historians can be fairly certain about the major climate changes that have affected the earth over many millennia. What is usually much less clear are the minor fluctuations within these major phases because they are inflected by a range of factors that remain in many cases to be fully investigated.
近年来发表了大量技术性很强的文献，历史学家和气候史家也已着手汇集这些材料，尝试综合其中一些成果。
这当然也不是全新的发展。例如，史前史研究者几十年来一直在思考气候、环境和早期人类社会与经济演变的关系。
不过，研究真正转向较近的历史，还是近二十来年的事。
这里也无须深入讨论技术繁复的古环境研究。它依靠一整套高度专门化的学科，研究太阳活动、树木年轮、冰川、碳-14和其他同位素、洞穴沉积物（钟乳石）、花粉、冰芯和海平面的变化。但如今已有足够的数据，而且还有更多数据正在采集和发表，使我们得以填补几千年、尤其最近两千年气候变化过程中的一些重要细节。

A great deal of highly technical literature has been published in recent years, and historians together with climate historians have recently begun to pull this material together and try to synthesize some of it.

This is not a completely new development, of course, since prehistorians, for example, have for many decades been thinking about the relationship between climate, environment, and the evolution of early human society and economy.
But it is really only in the last twenty or so years that attention has turned to more recent history.

Nor is this the place to enter the technically dense forest of paleo-environmental studies, depending as they do on a range of highly specialized disciplines— the study of solar activity, tree rings, glaciers, C14 and other isotopes, speleothems (stalactites), pollen, ice cores, and sea-level changes. But there is enough data now available, and more being collected and published, to enable us to fill in some significant details about the ways in which climate changed across several millennia, particularly over the last two millennia.
从长期来看，约公元前250年至公元200年的气候条件较为有利。之后的气候没有那么稳定，在寒冷干燥与温暖湿润之间出现了相当大的波动。大约400年之后，黎凡特南部的气候变得略为湿润，持续到七世纪中叶，随后进入较为干旱的阶段。安纳托利亚这一时期的区域差异似乎相当明显，中部和西部从六世纪初起更加湿润，一直持续到八世纪中叶。
对古海表温度证据的分析也表明，在约500—900年间，爱琴海北部和巴尔干南部较为湿润。
火山喷发及所谓的尘幕事件使情况更为复杂，约536至545年，气温因此急剧下降，对农业以及更广泛的人类健康也产生了相应影响。
480—520年及545—560年间似乎有某种稳定性，但也有数次短期干旱。541年，查士丁尼大瘟疫爆发，不过瘟疫、人类健康与当时变化中的气候背景，究竟如何相互关联，仍不清楚。
黎凡特在较短的时期转为更加湿润，记录可从四世纪后期追至七世纪，部分地区还可以再晚一些。有些历史学家把这与当时东罗马帝国的复兴和巩固联系起来。这种关联仍有争议，不过陶器及其他数据确实表明，同一时期经济活动可能有所加强。

The longer-term framework is set by the positive climatic conditions that lasted from ca. 250 BCE to ca. 200 CE but that then gave way to a less stable climate, with a considerable degree of fluctuation between cold and dry, and warm and wet periods. Thus, whereas in the southern Levant the climate became somewhat more humid after about 400 until the middle decades of the seventh century, when a more arid phase began, regional variation in Anatolia across these years appears to have been fairly marked, with wetter conditions in the center and west beginning in the early sixth century and lasting into the middle of the eighth century.
A wetter regime for the period ca. 500–900 in the northern Aegean and southern Balkan region is also indicated by an analysis of the evidence for ancient sea-surface temperatures.

The story is complicated by the impact of volcanic eruptions and a so-called dust-veil event, which meant that the years from ca. 536 to ca. 545 saw a particularly sharp drop in temperature with corresponding impacts on agriculture and human health more broadly.

While there seems to have been some stability in the years 480–520 and 545–560, there were also several short dry spells. In 541 the great Justinianic plague broke out, but the exact relationship between this, human health, and a changing climate context remains unclear.

In the Levant the short-term shift to a wetter regime that can be documented from the later fourth century into the seventh century and in parts beyond has been associated by some historians with the revival and consolidation of the Eastern Roman Empire at this time. While this association remains debated, it is certainly the case that ceramic and other data is suggestive of an intensification of economic activity during the same period.

总体而言，数据反映的公元二世纪后气候的不稳定与恶化，标志着此前四百年间所特有的相对稳定走到了尽头。变化在不同地区产生不同结果，也使区域差异显著扩大。有人提出，相当明确的因果关系可以把东西方的不同历史走向与这些气候趋势联系起来，但要说明这些关系实际上怎样起作用，仍然很难。许多地区没有相应数据，有些数据集的断代又不够准确，因此不可轻易断定有因果关联。气候史与更大尺度上的国家和社会演变有许多相似的变化，至少提示这类关联应当存在，确有必要细致辨析。要理解过去社会及国家形态的政治、社会和经济史，气候与古环境所起的作用，必须比我们以往解释中赋予它们的更重要。

In general terms, the instability and the deterioration in climate after the second century CE indicated by the data marked the end of the relative stability that had been characteristic of the previous four hundred years. It also marked a clear increase in regional variation as the changes impacted with different results in different regions. While some fairly clear causal connections have been posited between the different historical trajectories of east and west and these climatic trends, it is still difficult to demonstrate how these actually worked, and in view of both the absence of data from many areas as well as inadequate chronological control over some datasets, we should proceed carefully before making overly hasty causal associations. The many parallels between climatic history and the evolution of states and societies on the larger scale suggest at the very least that such associations should exist and do need to be teased out. Climate and the ancient environment must play a more important role in understanding the political, social, and economic history of past societies and state formations than they have done in our interpretation in the past.
因此，有必要简要说明，试图把气候和环境同其他证据所表明的社会、政治与文化生活的变化联系起来，会遇到哪些问题。首先要说明，气候条件的改变，除非异常严酷、剧烈，很少像一些过分简单的解释让我们相信的那样，直接改变社会组织和行为模式。气候科学家大多意识到了这一点。真正的问题，是怎样把气候及相关环境变化的不同影响，同社会和政治变化联系起来。

当然，也有人提出相当强的主张。例如，有学者认为，约630年东突厥汗国瓦解，是626年一次火山喷发的直接结果。这次喷发在平流层形成大范围的尘云，随之迫使气温在一段时间内骤降，游牧群体的牲畜和牧场遭到灾难性打击，导致大规模饥荒及社会内部的崩溃。中国同样受到影响，因此中国史料详细记载了约626—630年的异常降雪和霜冻。君士坦丁堡似乎也观察到了火山灰。当然，还须考虑政治和其他结构性的因素，但这是一个相对脆弱、缺乏弹性的社会生态很快就被重创、难以恢复的例子。又须把这个例子放进“古代晚期小冰期”的大背景中。小冰期本身很可能由南半球的火山活动触发，如今被认为从530年代后期延续到660年代。考虑这一点，上述解释就更有可能成立。
一般而言，气候与文化相互作用，且通常并不对称，虽然类似这个例子的情形显示出格外强烈的社会经济及文化影响。

So a brief word is in order about the problems that come with trying to relate climate and environment to the changes in social, political, and cultural life that our other evidence indicates. First, it needs to be made clear that shifts in climatic conditions, unless they are unusually severe and dramatic, rarely have the sort of direct impact in terms of changing patterns of social organization and behavior that more simplistic presentations of their effects would have us believe. Climate scientists are generally aware of this, so the real issue is how to relate the differential effects of climate and related environmental change to social and political change.

Some fairly dramatic claims can be made, of course: for example, it has been argued that the collapse of the eastern Turk khanate in the period ca. 630 was the direct result of a volcanic eruption in 626, an eruption that generated a substantial stratospheric dust cloud. This in turn had the effect of forcing a period of sudden cooling that impacted catastrophically on nomadic herds and pasturage and led to mass starvation and internal societal collapse. Chinese sources report in detail on the unusual snows and frosts for the period ca. 626–630 since China was similarly affected. Ash was apparently also observed in Constantinople. Of course, political and other structural factors must be taken into account as well, but this is an example of a situation in which a relatively fragile and inflexible social ecology would have been damaged beyond redemption very rapidly. Given that this must be set within the broader context of the “Late Antique Little Ice Age,” itself probably stimulated by volcanic activity in the southern hemisphere and now thought to have prevailed from the later 530s into the 660s, it seems all the more likely.
The relationship between climate and culture is generally synergistic and usually asymmetrical, although such cases as this express an unusually intense socioeconomic and cultural impact.

大多数社会文化体系能够承受一定程度的环境变化，并作出相应调整，而不至于瓦解。它们在回应中发生的改变程度可以极为不同，又取决于各社会体系自身的结构和各部分如何衔接。换言之，在社会实践的不同层面作出适应的能力，将决定整个体系能否有效应对变化。因此，韧性、适应能力和灵活性都是关键，而历史和考古记录常能让我们对这些特性知之甚详。气候通常使既有趋势更为显著，并非直接导致事情发生。在代用数据中可以观察到的气候变化的强度、持续时间和空间范围，是决定其作用的关键要素。也正因为气候能放大已有趋势，我们在理解社会、政治、经济的演变时，就有必要将气候考虑在内。在本章和第七章，这一点将会变得明显。气候因素所施加的外力，例如愈来愈寒冷或湿润的时期对农业实践或水资源管理体系、以及伴随它们的社会实践和态度的影响，可能相当重要。同时也须记住，文化或社会文化也可能施加外力。人类活动会影响环境，从而间接引发社会行为甚至信仰模式的变化，这也同样重要。

Most social-cultural systems can absorb a certain degree of change in their environment and make the appropriate adjustments without breaking down. And the degree of change evident in their response can vary enormously and depends in turn on the internal structure and articulation of the societal systems in question. In other words, their ability to adapt at different levels of social praxis will determine the success or failure of the system as a whole to respond effectively to change. Resilience, adaptability, and flexibility are thus crucial aspects, and these are the sorts of quality about which the historical and archaeological record can often tell us a great deal. Climate generally acts to amplify preexisting tendencies without being the direct cause of anything, and the intensity, length, and spatial extent of the climatic changes that can be observed in the proxy data will be key determining elements. But because it can have this amplifying effect, it is important to build it into our understanding of social, political, and economic evolution. This will become obvious in this chapter and in Chapter 7. Forcing by climatic factors— that is to say, the impact of, say, increasingly cool or humid periods on agricultural practices or on water-management systems and the social praxis and attitudes that accompany them— can be very important. But by the same token we should also bear in mind that cultural or sociocultural forcing can also occur— human activities that impact on the environment in such a way as indirectly to bring about shifts in societal behaviors and even of patterns of belief are just as important.
还须记住，气候的影响会在不同尺度上起作用。较大范围的区域变化，在次区域和更小的地方尺度上，可能产生非常不同的影响。这要由地方特点决定，例如离海有多近，有没有山地，等等。举例来说，公元四至八世纪气候条件的变化，对安纳托利亚及其各次区域、巴尔干和黎凡特的影响不同，造成了它们的经济史以及部分政治史上的显著差异。

Another important point to bear in mind is the different levels at which climatic impacts can have an effect. Larger regional shifts can have very different impacts at subregional and microregional levels, determined by local features such as proximity to the sea, the presence or absence of mountainous terrain, and so forth. The differences in the consequences of changing climatic conditions on Anatolia and its sub-regions, on the Balkans, and on the Levant in the fourth through eighth centuries CE, for example, make for very significant variations in their economic histories and to some extent their political histories.
如我在本章和下一章所指出的，现有证据揭示了一些值得探究的可能性。
到七世纪后期，安纳托利亚已是东罗马国家仅存的最大一片连续陆地，现在已逐渐能够看出那里有一些值得注意的重大变化。把这些变化放在帝国其他地区的气候史旁边比较，例如西西里和意大利南部，就能帮助我们理解拜占庭国家如何应对七、八世纪的剧变。
As I suggest in this and the next chapter, there are some interesting possibilities arising from the evidence that is available.

In the case of Anatolia, the major single landmass remaining to the eastern Roman state by the late seventh century, it is becoming possible to detect some interesting and significant developments. Set in the context of other parts of the empire and their climate history, such as Sicily and southern Italy, for example, these developments can help us to understand how the Byzantine state responded to the dramatic events and transformations of the seventh and eighth centuries.
安纳托利亚：气候与土地利用
Anatolia: Climate and Land Use
巴尔干南部，尤其是安纳托利亚半岛，受影响地中海地区的三个大尺度天气系统所支配，即大西洋系统、南亚季风系统，以及以俄罗斯和西伯利亚上空为中心的大陆气候系统。
安纳托利亚独特的地理条件，使当地形成了一个尤其复杂、内部差异丰富的区域子系统。

不过，由于二十世纪以前的记录极为有限，解释土耳其中部内陆与东部地区复杂的环境变化，尤其困难。近来的研究揭示了一些值得注意的情况，我们可以借此理解拜占庭如何应对七世纪后期、八世纪初的危机。首先，大背景是530年代开始的所谓古代晚期小冰期。530和540年代发生了一系列大型火山喷发，随后一段时期的季节性气温异常偏低。这在多大程度上与查士丁尼瘟疫、草原游牧人群西迁存在因果关系，仍是悬而未决的问题，实际上才刚刚开始得到认真而细致的讨论。其次，学界现已普遍认为，安纳托利亚许多地方从六世纪到七世纪后期经历了较为湿润的气候，有些地区可能持续至八世纪初。这个阶段结束的时间，随证据的采集地点而异。卡帕多西亚中部的纳尔湖（Nar Gölü），以及安卡拉以东、靠近昌克勒（甘格拉）的乔尔湖（Çöl Gölü），都是高原中部的典型地区，湿润期约在750年结束。卡帕多西亚西北部的泰杰尔湖（Tecer Gölü）从八世纪后期变得更干旱，而安纳托利亚西南部格拉夫加兹（Gravgaz）沼泽的证据表明，那里的干旱来得更早，从七世纪中叶便开始了。
（见表6.1。）须留意数据本身有限，不过在安纳托利亚各地，这一格局似乎反复出现，时间上略有差别。事实上，更广阔的东地中海和黎凡特的现有文字证据，也提示这种形势使气候更加不稳定。从六世纪后期到八世纪，安纳托利亚出现严寒冬季的次数相对较多，而且似乎有异常严重的霜冻和降雪，旱灾及其他与干旱有关的事件却相对少见。

The southern Balkans and especially the Anatolian peninsula are influenced by three global weather systems that affect the Mediterranean zone: the Atlantic, the south Asian monsoonal system, and the continental climate system anchored over Russia and Siberia.
In light of the particular geography of Anatolia, this makes for a particularly complex and nuanced regional subsystem,

although interpreting the complexities of environmental change in central-interior and eastern regions of Turkey is particularly problematic because of very poor records from before the twentieth century. But recent work has shown up some interesting developments, and we can exploit these to help us to understand the Byzantine response to the crisis of the later seventh and early eighth centuries. Firstly, the broad context is framed by the onset in the 530s of the so-called Late Antique Little Ice Age, a period of unusually cooler seasonal temperatures following a series of major volcanic eruptions in the 530s and 540s. The extent to which this was causally related to the Justinianic plague and to the movement of nomadic peoples on the steppe westward remains unresolved and indeed has barely begun to be discussed seriously and in detail. Secondly, it is now broadly agreed that much of Anatolia experienced a somewhat wetter climate during the sixth and up to the later seventh century, possibly stretching in some areas into the early eighth century. The end of this phase varies depending on the site from which the evidence is drawn—at Nar Gölü in central Cappadocia and at Çöl Gölü near Çankırı (Gangra) to the east of Ankara, regions typical of the central sections of the plateau, it ends ca. 750; at Tecer Gölü in northwest Cappadocia it becomes more arid from the later eighth century, whereas evidence from Gravgaz marsh in southwest Anatolia suggests an earlier onset of aridity, from the middle of the seventh century.

(See Table 6.1.) While it is important to be aware of the limited nature of the data, this pattern seems to be repeated with minor chronological variations across Anatolia. Indeed, the available textual evidence from the wider eastern Mediterranean and Levantine context certainly hints at the instability that these conditions promoted, with a comparatively greater number of very severe winters and apparently unusually severe frosts and snows across the later sixth and into the eighth century in Anatolia, but with relatively few droughts and aridity-related events.

这样的气候图景是否与土地利用的变化相吻合，是另一个问题。多种植物的花粉可以反映人类活动，例如谷类、橄榄树和坚果树的花粉，或者牲畜爱吃的牧草的花粉。花粉也反映了取代人工栽培作物，或扩展到以往曾开垦耕种的土地上的自然植被。因此，花粉可以显示某些格局，提示人们种了什么、什么时候种植、何时又停止种植。安纳托利亚各地的花粉数据表明，一直到六、七世纪，整个地区可以利用的耕地与牧地都得到较为集约的利用，各小区域的情况则因地而异。花粉学记录及考古证据都显示，安纳托利亚许多地方往往人口相当稠密，实行混合农业，连条件较差的土地也常常被开垦。但从六世纪中叶起，安纳托利亚集约且相对同质的土地利用开始退缩；在巴尔干南部与安纳托利亚大部分地区，与既有BOP农业方式相联系的整套作物与活动也随之退缩。各地转变的速度不尽相同，原有格局逐渐被自然植被或种类较少的作物取代。先前的农业体系看来趋于简化。

Whether this picture of the climate coincides with changes in land use is another question. Pollen from a range of flora reflect human activities— the pollen from cereals, olive, and nut trees, for example, or the types of grasses favored for grazing livestock. They also reflect the natural vegetation that grows to replace anthropogenic crops or expands to occupy formerly tilled arable land. Pollen can thus indicate particular patterns suggesting both what was grown and when it was grown or ceased to be grown. Pollen data taken from sites across Anatolia show that the exploitable arable and pastoral land across the region was relatively intensively exploited into the sixth and seventh centuries, with subregional variations according to local conditions. Both the palynological record as well as the archaeological evidence suggest that an often densely inhabited landscape characterized by mixed farming was typical of much of the region and included often quite marginal land. But beginning in the middle of the sixth century this intensive and relatively homogenous exploitation of land in Anatolia receded, along with the bundle of crops and activities associated across the southern Balkans and much of Anatolia with the established BOP agricultural regime. At different rates according to area, the established pattern is gradually replaced either by natural vegetation or by a more limited range of crops. There appears to have been a simplification of the preexisting agrarian regimes.
虽然所有迹象都显示人类活动总体有所衰退，
但在已经缩小的生产规模中，谷物生产和畜牧业所占的分量似乎反而增加了。许多地区的葡萄和橄榄栽培显著减少，
各种坚果树的花粉也显著减少。不过，仍有明显的例外。例如在米利都地区，花粉数据表明，从五世纪到十四世纪，农业格局一直延续，没有中断，同时也显示出生产规模明显缩小。
同样，在安纳托利亚西北部、靠近君士坦丁堡的比提尼亚一些地方，BOP时期既有的作物组合似乎延续了下来。相比之下，在比提尼亚沿海地区，证据表明当地更依赖畜牧，谷物和水果生产则有所减少。有学者将此视为七世纪后半叶与八世纪初局势更加不稳的反映，当时阿拉伯人频繁由海上进攻小亚细亚西北部的沿海地区。不过也不应忽略，首都腹地市场需求的变化可能同样起了作用。
本都内陆地区的有限花粉数据（出自拉迪克、代米尔尤尔特和卡兹）表明，七世纪之后，农作种植总体衰退，这与沿海地带看来有所不同。这些材料的断代仍有问题，但看起来指向一种趋势，约700年之后，在如此深入内陆的地方，没有明显迹象显示农业活动有所增加。
Even though all the indications point to an overall decline in human activity,

cereal production and stock-raising appear to increase in significance proportionate to this reduced level of production. The cultivation of vines and olives recedes dramatically from many areas, and there

is also a marked reduction in the presence of pollen from nut trees of all types. There are, nevertheless, clear exceptions. In the Miletus region, for example, the pollen data show uninterrupted continuity in the agricultural pattern from the fifth to the fourteenth century (while at the same time indicating a marked reduction in production levels).

Likewise, in parts of Bithynia in northwest Anatolia, close to Constantinople, the traditional BOP suite of cultivars seems to continue. In the coastal regions of Bithynia, in contrast, the evidence suggests an increased reliance on pastoral farming and a reduction in cereal and fruit production. While this has been seen by one scholar as a reflection of the less secure situation of the second half of the seventh and early eighth centuries, when Arab seaborne attacks on the northwest Asia Minor coastal regions were frequent, we should not lose sight of the possibility that changing market demand in the metropolitan hinterland might also have played a role.

In the inner Pontic region the limited pollen data suggest, in apparent contrast to the coastal zones, a decline in general cultivation after the seventh century (evidence from Ladik, Demiryurt, and Kaz). While the chronology from this material remains problematic, it nevertheless seems to indicate a trend, with no obvious signs of increasing agricultural activity that far inland after ca. 700.

因此，从六世纪后期或七世纪起，安纳托利亚许多地方的共同特征，是农牧体系趋于简化、地区差异加大，以及整个地区生产活动的规模萎缩。许多原先开垦的边缘土地被放弃，在一些地方，耕作强度也剧烈降低，这些也表明许多地方，乃至大部分地区的乡村人口有所减少。卡帕多西亚、小亚细亚西南部的一些地方、比提尼亚与西北部的一些地区，以及帕夫拉戈尼亚东部的锡诺普一带，看来都是这样。
除一两个例子外，这些变化的断代仍极为宽泛，从六世纪一直延伸到八世纪。虽然须记住证据并不连贯，还要有更多的采样点才能覆盖得更全面，但整体情形似乎的确相当符合文献和考古证据所显示的当时状况，前面已略述，另有详细论述。
许多采样点还共同显示，约一百至一百五十年之后，花粉中出现了又一次明显的转变。这种简化的生产方式有所强化，大规模畜牧有所发展，但有些地方的葡萄、橄榄和水果又出现了。这些变化既与九世纪后期到十世纪的帝国政治和经济恢复同时发生，也与从七至八世纪延续到十至十一世纪的干旱期告终相吻合。

A simplified and more regionally diverse agropastoral regime and a reduced level of activity across the region as a whole were therefore common features across much of Anatolia from the later sixth or seventh century. A retreat from many marginal areas that had been farmed formerly and in some cases a dramatic reduction in the intensity of farming are suggestive also of a reduced rural population in many, if not most, areas. This seems to be the case in Cappadocia, in parts of southwestern Asia Minor, to a degree in Bithynia and the northwest, and in eastern Paphlagonia in the Sinope region.

Apart from one or two cases, the chronology of these changes remains very broad, stretching from the sixth into the eighth century. But while we should recall that the evidence is patchy and that many more sample sites are needed to offer a fuller coverage, the overall picture does seem to fit well with what is known from the textual and the archaeological evidence about conditions at this period, conditions described briefly already and discussed in detail elsewhere.

Another feature common to a number of sites is that, after a period of some 100–150 years, a further shift becomes evident in the pollen, namely an intensification of this simplified regime, an expansion of large-scale pastoral farming but with the reappearance in some contexts of vines, olives, and fruit. These developments coincide both with the political and economic recovery of the empire in the course of the later ninth and tenth centuries as well as with the end of the arid period that lasts from the seventh to eighth century into the tenth to eleventh century.

至此应当清楚了，这种简化开始的时间，既不能同阿拉伯人入侵等已知政治事件一一对上，也无法同某一次单独的“气候变化”严丝合缝地配合。古气候数据表明安纳托利亚各地差异极大，这的确说明气候不稳定是导致花粉中所见的变化快慢不一的重要因素，也说明六、七世纪不同时段里变化的速度不一样。在某些地区，例如高原西缘的贝伊谢希尔湖周围或皮西迪亚的萨加拉索斯一带，变化自六世纪上半叶至七世纪中叶陆续发生，即便在很小的范围内，地方差异也很大。吕基亚沿海与南爱琴海沿岸采样点出现变化的时间更早。七世纪是比提尼亚发生关键转变的时期，帕夫拉戈尼亚和本都的部分地区也是如此，尽管某些地方的传统作物组合也许维持到了八世纪。至于卡帕多西亚的大部分地区，670年代似乎标志着BOP的结束。
锡诺普地区东南部的细密考古调查表明，聚落密度从四世纪起明显上升，与面向市场的集约橄榄油生产有关。但环境记录和考古也显示，七世纪的某个时候，聚落的密度与数量大幅下降。研究者又将此与花粉记录所显示的当地橄榄生产崩溃联系起来。

It should by now be clear that the onset of this simplification cannot be made to coincide neatly either with known political events, such as the Arab invasions, nor can it be made to fit neatly with a single “climate change” event. The high degree of regional variation across Anatolia indicated by the paleoclimatic data does suggest that climatic instability was a significant factor in the variable rates of change evident in the pollen, and indicates different rates of change across the sixth and seventh centuries. In some areas, such as around Lake Beyşehir on the western edge of the plateau or around Sagalassos in Pisidia, the change sets in across the period from the first half of the sixth into the mid-seventh century but with a high level of local variation across quite a small area; at the coastal sites in Lycia and on the southern Aegean littoral it appears even earlier; in Bithynia the seventh century marks the key shift, in parts of Paphlagonia and Pontus likewise, although the traditional suite of cultivars may have survived into the eighth century in certain localities, while in much of Cappadocia the 670s appear to denote the end of the BOP.

The results of intensive archaeological survey in the southeast part of the Sinope region indicate a very clear rise in settlement density from the fourth century associated with an intensive market-orientated olive oil production. But the environmental record and the archaeology also suggest that at some point in the seventh century there was a dramatic decline in settlement density and numbers. This has in turn been linked to a collapse of olive production in the region, indicated in the pollen record.
这可能与气温开始下降有关，橄榄对低温特别敏感。如前述，当时书面记载中的零星事例确实暗示了降温。不过，代用气候数据并未表明安纳托利亚在这一时点发生了重大变化，而有关这个小区域气温的古气候证据，尚不足以判断当时的湿润条件是否也是气候总体趋凉的一部分。

因此，目前不妨提出一个假设，平均气温较低或许起了作用，然而也很有可能，主要原因是锡诺普腹地及更远地区的市场形势发生了变化，再加上540年代起遍及东地中海和安纳托利亚的地方性瘟疫的长远影响。考古所证实的锡诺普半岛一带极为稠密的聚落，当然可能受到瘟疫的严重影响。市场形势发生这类变化，加上人口的下降，确实符合考古记录所显示的东地中海和爱琴海地区更大范围的变化趋势。值得注意的是，比提尼亚的屈曲克阿克湖（Küçük Akgöl）离君士坦丁堡近得多，其周围的花粉指标显示，约在七世纪的最后二十五年里，当地引入了橄榄栽培。人们很容易想把两者联系起来，即使尚无法清楚证明有直接关系。

This may have been associated with the onset of cooler temperatures, to which the olive is especially sensitive, and which are certainly suggested anecdotally by the documentary record for the period, as already noted. But the proxy climate data do not suggest any significant shifts at this point for Anatolia, and the paleoclimatic evidence for temperature for this microregion is still inadequate to determine whether the wetter conditions of the period were also part of a generally cooler climate.

For the present, therefore, we might hypothesize that, while cooler average temperatures may have played a role, it may just as likely have been changing market conditions, both in the Sinope hinterland as well as further afield, that were primarily responsible, with the longer-term impact of the endemic plague that sets in from the 540s across the whole eastern Mediterranean and Anatolian region (the archaeologically attested extremely dense settlement-pattern of the Sinope peninsula region could certainly have been negatively affected by plague). Such changing market conditions combined with a demographic downturn would certainly fit the broader pattern of change in the east Mediterranean and Aegean regions detectable in the archaeological record. Interestingly, the pollen indicators for the region around the site of Küçük Akgöl in Bithynia, a site much closer to Constantinople, show the introduction of oleoculture around the last quarter of the seventh century. It is tempting to link the two, even if no direct relationship can be clearly demonstrated.
所有这些例子的数据中，各小区域的差异都相当清楚，表明就总体而言，这种转变取决于若干高度地方化的因素。例如，伊斯坦布尔附近屈曲克切克梅杰（Küçükçekmece）潟湖的代用气候数据表明，在普遍较为干旱的条件下，间或有过几次短暂的较湿润时期。

In all of these cases a fairly clear degree of subregional variation can be read off from the data to suggest that, within the big picture, the shift depended on a number of highly localized factors. Thus, the generally drier conditions were interspersed with a few short, wetter, periods, as illustrated by the proxy climate data from the Küçükçekmece lagoon near Istanbul.
不过，虽然八世纪上半叶是由湿润转向更干旱的时期，但即使在我们相当确定气候确实改变的地方，许多地区的农业也直到很久以后才有变化。例如在锡诺普周边之外的帕夫拉戈尼亚地区、本都、高原中部和安纳托利亚西部沿海的某些采样点，新旧两种农业体系曾有一段时间并存。在卡帕多西亚的大部分地区，670年代似乎标志着既有农业格局的终结。
如已提及的，比提尼亚沿海地区的证据表明，当地更依赖畜牧，而谷物与水果产量降低，内陆地区则似乎仍不间断地实行晚期罗马时期具有代表性的农业方式。
因此，有些地方农民所种作物的变化可能与气候变化相对应，另一些地方却没有这种对应。单靠气候显然无法解释这些变化。（见表6.2。）

Yet, while the first half of the eighth century marks a change from humid to more arid, even where we are fairly sure that the climate really was changing, there is no change at all in the agriculture of many regions until much later. In areas of Paphlagonia other than around Sinope, or in the Pontus, for example, as well as on the central plateau and at certain sites in the western coastal regions of Anatolia, old and new regimes existed for a while side by side. In much of Cappadocia the 670s appear to denote the end of the established pattern of agriculture.

As I have already noted, in the coastal regions of Bithynia the evidence indicates an increased reliance on pastoral farming and a reduction in cereal and fruit production, whereas inland the agriculture typical of the previous late Roman regime appears to continue without a break.

So while in some areas changes in what farmers grew may be paralleled by climatic shifts, in others there is no such parallel. It seems clear that climate cannot alone have accounted for the changes. (See Table 6.2.)
最后，还有一点同样重要。地中海地区有一些值得注意的气候现象，与北纬约40度一线南北两侧

降水与气温的反向变化有关。这是纬向气候带收缩或扩张的结果，即所谓热带辐合带朝向或远离赤道移动的结果。在全球降温的时期，意大利中部以北的欧洲越来越冷、越来越干，也有一些地区差异；代用数据和气候模型则表明，在这种条件下，北纬约40度以南的地中海地区会变得更暖、更湿润。而在全球变暖的时期，情形正好相反，北纬40度以南更干，以北则更湿润。这对于我们关注的时代究竟有何意义，尚不清楚。在取得更多代用气候数据前，还无法将这一信息纳入对该区域的认识。
Last, but by no means least, there are some interesting climatic phenomena associated in the Mediterranean region with inverse patterns

of precipitation and temperature on either side of a line at around 40 degrees latitude north. This is an effect of the contraction or expansion of horizontal climatic bands (the movement toward or away from the equator of the so-called Intertropical Convergence Zone). In periods of global cooling, Europe north of central Italy becomes cooler and drier— again with some regional variation— while proxy data and climatic modeling suggest that under such conditions the Mediterranean south of approximately 40 degrees becomes warmer and wetter. In contrast, during periods of global warming this pattern is reversed: the region south of 40 degrees becomes drier and that to the north, wetter. It is not yet clear what the implications of this are for the period with which we are concerned, and until more proxy climate data are available, it will not be possible to integrate this information into the regional picture.

总之，花粉学证据强烈表明，传统土地利用方式在若干地区衰退，在另一些地方则延续下去，还有些地方的畜牧和谷物种植越来越重要，同时人口也可能下降。关于城市聚落性质及范围的考古证据也印证了这一点，虽然如何准确理解其中一些数据，仍是争论很激烈的问题。不过，要把农业体系的这些变化与可以证实的气候变化联系起来，仍然很难。
无论采取哪种看法，看来都可以肯定，五世纪后期到八世纪上半叶，安纳托利亚大部分地区的气候不太稳定，总体较为湿润，随后的年代又转为更加干旱。这让一些农业活动比从前更难维持，或许是各小区域被迫转向一种更简单、不易受损、因而对人而言也更稳妥的农业经济方式的原因之一。

In summary, the palynological evidence is very suggestive of a retreat of the traditional patterns of land use from several areas, its continuation in others, and the increasing importance of stock-raising and cereal farming in other regions, all accompanied by a probably declining population. The archaeological evidence for the nature and extent of urban settlement corroborates this, even though there continues a robust debate on exactly how to interpret some of this data. But relating these changes in the agrarian regime to the shifts in climate that can be documented remains problematic.

Whichever perspective is adopted, it seems clear that the less stable, mostly wetter conditions in much of Anatolia across the period from the later fifth through into the first half of the eighth century and the ensuing greater aridity of the following years rendered some agricultural activities more marginal than before and might suggest one reason for the forcing, microregion by microregion, of a less vulnerable, simpler, and thus, from the human perspective, safer mode of agrarian economy.
复杂性与成因
Complexity and Causes

影响人口、农业产量与耕作策略的其他关键因素，包括流行病和战争，二者经常以这样或那样的方式相联系。必须把查士丁尼瘟疫这一重要因素考虑进去，并放在东地中海盆地和黎凡特的长期历史中考察。瘟疫始于540年代初，迅速席卷欧亚大陆西部。有些地区的总死亡人数，估计占人口的25%到50%。不过，要找到定量证据、准确估计其人口影响，非常困难。其影响无疑因人口与聚落的密度，或因自然环境因素而异，例如530年代后期的尘幕事件。瘟疫确实产生了影响，而且在某些地区影响极大，这一点没有争议。曾试图估计这一时期东罗马帝国人口规模的学者，都一致认为，从六世纪中叶到七世纪后期，人口急剧下降。例如，约400年罗马帝国东部人口的估计值，在两千四百万至两千六百万之间。到了约600年，已减少到一千万或一千两百万至一千九百万之间。到九世纪初，只剩七百万至一千万。
这类计算或估计并未明确计入领土丧失，因此像安纳托利亚这样的特定地区，人口减少的程度仍然未知，也可能无从知道。当然，所有这类估计都仍十分依赖假设。
城市聚落格局的变化，在安纳托利亚内部同样有显著的地方差异，也必然反映出可用人力、地方与跨地区市场需求，因而也反映出生产规模的变化。

Other key factors that affected demography, agricultural production, and farming strategies included epidemic disease and warfare— very often linked in one way or another. The Justinianic plague is one important factor that needs to be taken into account and placed in the longer-term context of the eastern Mediterranean basin and the Levant and their history. Beginning in the early 540s, it rapidly engulfed the western Eurasian world, with estimates of the overall mortality ranging between 25–50 percent of the population in some areas. But it is difficult to find any quantitative evidence in order to gage its precise impact in demographic terms. Its effects certainly varied according to population and settlement density or natural environmental factors, such as the dust-veil event of the late 530s. That it did have an impact, and in some regions a very dramatic one, is not at issue, and scholars who have attempted to estimate the size of the population of the Eastern Roman Empire at this period are all in agreement that the population shrank dramatically between the mid-sixth century and the later seventh. Thus, estimates of the population of the eastern part of the Roman Empire ca. 400 vary from 24–26 million, declining to a low of anything between 10 or 12 to 19 million ca. 600, and to a mere 7 to 10 million by the early ninth century.

Such calculations or estimates do not take the loss of territory explicitly into account, so the degree of decline within a particular region such as Anatolia remains unknown (and probably unknowable). And, of course, all such estimates remain extremely hypothetical.

The shifts in patterns of urban settlement, again heavily nuanced by subregion within Anatolia, must also reflect shifts in the availability of human resources, the demands of local and interregional markets, and, thus, levels of production.

此外，七世纪后半叶的入侵和战争也产生了明显影响。迄今只有一个采样点的古环境数据能与历史证据精确相合，但它鲜明地显示了七世纪后半叶持续的劫掠和军事行动可能产生怎样的影响。纳尔湖位于纳齐安佐斯东南约二十公里、马拉科佩亚（代林库尤，Derinküyü）西南约三十公里，正处于七世纪阿拉伯人屡次袭击的地区中心（地图6.3）。分析花粉序列，能够为周边地区约一千七百年的植被格局提供分辨率很高的记录，向前追溯到约公元300年，让我们得以了解这段时期发生的植被变化。约公元300至670年，花粉特征表明，当地以相当集约的混合农业为主，也有落叶栎林、其他林地和以禾草为主的草原。这种农业体系也反映于
土耳其西南部和西部其他采样点的花粉中，与BOP有关。
这种农业体系在七世纪告终，人类活动指标几乎消失，意味着农业活动显著衰退，林地则有所扩张。松树花粉占比持续上升，也是这一时期安纳托利亚西部许多花粉图谱的典型特征。这似乎体现了托罗斯山及本都山脉的松林相当急剧地扩张，尽管扩张地点很可能离纳尔湖有一定距离。
与草原植被相联系的禾草花粉占比，这一时期也有所下降，可能意味着原先放牧牲畜的一些地方，也重新长满了灌丛。

Additionally, the invasions and warfare of the second half of the seventh century had a noticeable effect, and, although there is to date only one site where paleo-environmental data can be tied in exactly to the historical evidence, it is starkly suggestive of the impact the constant raiding and hostile activity of the second half of the seventh century could have. The evidence from Lake Nar, some twenty kilometers southeast of Nazianzos and thirty kilometers southwest of Malakopea (Derinküyü), is located in the center of areas that were the subject of repeated Arab attacks in the seventh century (Map 6.3). The analysis of the pollen sequence provides a very high-resolution record of vegetation patterns in the surrounding district for some 1,700 years, back to about 300 CE, information that tells us about the changes in vegetation that took place over this period. It shows that during the period ca. 300–ca. 670 CE the pollen signature reflects a mixed and fairly intensive agrarian regime dominated alongside areas of deciduous oak, woodland, and grass-dominated steppe, a regime reflected also in the pollen from
other sites in southwestern and western Turkey and associated with the BOP.

This agrarian regime comes to an end during the seventh century, and the near disappearance of anthropogenic indicators implies a period of marked decline in agricultural activity and an expansion of woodland, while the sustained increase in pine pollen percentages, typical of many other western Anatolian pollen diagrams for this period, thus seems to reflect a fairly dramatic expansion of pine forests across the Taurus and Pontic mountain chains, albeit probably at some distance from Nar.

Pollen percentages for grasses associated with steppe vegetation also decline in this period, possibly implying that some areas previously dedicated to livestock grazing were also recolonized by scrub.

不过，同其他采样点不同，纳尔湖湖底的逐年沉积，能够精确测定具有代表性的各类花粉发生重大变化的年代。因此，BOP的结束可以确定在一个相当窄的时间范围里，精确地落在公元664至678年之间。
在这短短一段时期里，大部分显示人类农牧活动的证据明显减少。取而代之的是，与次生灌丛和林地发展相关的树木花粉，其百分比上升。这通常表示灌丛和林地正在向新近弃耕的土地扩展。
这一点很重要，因为专业的花粉分布分析表明，纳尔湖中沉积的花粉多数来自较广的区域，而非仅仅就近产生。湖畔约五平方公里以内的土地利用变化，可能也影响了花粉的构成，但这些记录还反映了卡帕多西亚大部地区的地貌与植被变化，范围达约五千平方公里或更广。
纳尔湖的记录体现了一种区域格局：约664—678年，大范围农业活动的证据似乎消失了，或者在统计上减到了最低，直到十世纪中叶才重新出现，但重心已有不同。（见图6.1与表6.3。）

Unlike other sites, however, the annual sedimentation from the lake bed at Nar permits exact dates to be achieved for the major changes in representative pollen types, so the end of the BOP can be fixed within a fairly tight timeframe and placed with great precision in the period from 664 to 678 CE.

During this short time most of the evidence of human agricultural and pastoral activity decreases markedly, to be replaced by an increase in the percentage values of pollen from arboreal species associated with secondary scrub and woodland development generally related to encroachment onto recently abandoned agricultural land.

This is significant because specialist pollen distribution analyses suggest that most pollen deposited in Nar Gölü was regional rather than local in origin— although local land-use changes in the immediate vicinity of the lake (an area of some five square kilometers) probably affected the composition of the pollen, the record also reflects landscape and vegetation changes across much of Cappadocia (thus, from an area of some five thousand square kilometers or more).

The Nar record reflects a regional pattern in which the evidence for extensive human agricultural activities appears to cease or be reduced to a statistical minimum in the period ca. 664–678, to resume again, albeit with different emphases, only in the middle of the tenth century. 这是对人们所理解的战争影响的一份引人注目的记录。修辞上无疑有所夸张，但它记述了这类战争给土地和居民带来的影响，也得到编年史证据的支持。
除了考古和实地调查的证据，还可在史料中找到前文提及的那种强制迁徙，即把巴尔干的被俘人口迁到小亚细亚遭受蹂躏的地区，弥补当地因被俘或死亡而失去的人力。
此外还有文献和考古证据显示，居民逃离原地，聚落也迁到较易防守的地方。时代稍晚的圣徒传都提到这类战争造成的破坏。事实上，小亚细亚有些地方从七世纪起接连遭受袭击，到十世纪后期似乎才开始复苏。这一点也由纳尔湖的数据证实了。这里尚未计入编年史和历史著作的叙事证据。
七世纪的一部“新兵”圣狄奥多尔奇迹集记载，欧凯塔这座屡遭围攻的要塞城远在这里所讨论地区的北面，其居民曾考虑弃家而去，找一个不那么危险的地方（确有一两处有据可查的地方这么做了）。书中说“萨拉森人一年一度的袭掠到来时”，措辞近乎例行。
This is a dramatic record, no doubt exaggerated for rhetorical effect, of the perceived impact of such warfare on the land and its inhabitants. It is corroborated by the evidence of the chronicles.

Apart from the archaeological and survey evidence, there are also the references in the sources to the compulsory transplanting of captive populations from the Balkans into devastated regions of Asia Minor, noted in an earlier chapter, in order to make good the loss of manpower through captivity and death.

There is also written and archaeological evidence for the flight of populations as well as the movement of settlements to more defensible locations. Hagiographies of a slightly later period all make reference to the devastation caused by such warfare; indeed, in some cases it seems that areas in Asia Minor first attacked in the seventh century, and regularly thereafter, were still only at the beginning of recovery in the later tenth century— another point nicely confirmed by the Nar Gölü data. And this is, of course, apart from the narrative evidence of the chronicles and histories of the period.

In the seventh-century account of the miracles of St. Theodore “the recruit,” the population of the beleaguered fortress town of Euchaïta, much further north than the area discussed here, consider abandoning their homes in an effort to locate a less hazardous environment (as did indeed happen in one or two documented cases), and the text speaks almost mechanically in terms of “when the yearly raid of the Saracens came.”

即使把书面史料的种种偏向考虑在内，这些材料仍为解读纳尔湖花粉数据提供了背景。它们几乎毫无疑问地表明，664至678年的某个时候，湖泊周围（肯定包括科洛尼亚即阿克萨赖）种植传统作物的规模大幅缩小。橄榄和葡萄的栽培停止，或严重缩减，种植谷物的迹象几乎完全从记录中消失。这一现象没有气候方面的解释。如此剧烈的变化，只能用当时给当地带来毁灭性打击的战争来解释。当地并未完全无人居住，考古发现或文献提及的若干小聚落和要塞继续存在，说明了这一点。不过，数据的确显示，当地经济发生了彻底转变，也可以有把握地推断，伴随着相当大规模的人口减少。这一时期战争发生的地方，与其他同样出现这一变化的采样点在地理上重合。由此看来，这些地区的传统农业体系，即前面所说以BOP为特征的体系，显然完全是由于人为因素和相关现象而告终，包括战争及其伴随的瘟疫与饥荒。

Allowing for all the biases in the written sources, this material nevertheless offers a context for the interpretation of the Lake Nar pollen data. They suggest beyond any reasonable doubt that at some point between 664 and 678 the region around the lake, an area certainly encompassing Koloneia (Aksaray), suffered a massive retrenchment in terms of traditionally cultivated crops. Oleoculture and viticulture cease or were seriously curtailed, while cereal production disappears from the record almost entirely. There is no climatological explanation for this phenomenon; indeed, such a dramatic change can only be explained in terms of the devastating warfare of the period that affected this area. Human occupation did not cease: the continued existence of a number of small settlements and fortresses, located archaeologically or referred to in the written sources, makes this clear. But the data do indicate a complete change in the economy of the region accompanied, it may safely be assumed, by a considerable reduction in population. And in view of the geographical coincidence of the warfare of the period with other sites associated with this change, it would seem clear that the traditional agricultural regime— characterized by the BOP discussed earlier— was ended in these regions entirely as a result of anthropogenic factors and associated phenomena: warfare and its accompaniments, pestilence and famine.

花粉数据所显示的664—678年人类农业活动急剧而显著的收缩，诚然意义重大，但约二百八十年后，同样由花粉数据揭示的复苏，也同样引人注意。这些证据呈现出该地区人类经济活动的一种不同格局：谷物生产、放牧或规模较大的畜牧业更为突出，而在BOP突然告终以前，果园与园艺作物的栽培则更为广泛。花粉所显示的农业复兴，与十世纪后期帝国在该地区较为广泛的经济及政治复苏相吻合。约公元1100年又有一次衰退，约一个世纪后再次恢复。这很可能同塞尔柱人占领该地区后大规模放弃生产谷物，以及当地在十三世纪初恢复政治和经济稳定后逐渐重新种植谷物有关。

As significant as the pollen data for the radical and dramatic retrenchment of human agrarian activities in the period 664–678 may be, the later recovery indicated by the pollen data that took place some 280 years later is equally impressive. This evidence presents a somewhat different configuration of the human economy of the region, with a more obvious emphasis on cereal production and pastoral farming or ranching—in contrast to the greater extent of orchard and garden crops of the BOP before its abrupt termination. Here there is a coincidence of the pollen evidence for a reviving agrarian economy and the broader economic and political recovery of the empire in this region in the later tenth century, as well as a further downturn ca. 1100 CE and a subsequent recovery about a century later. This can most likely be associated with the occupation of this area by the Seljuks, the abandonment of cereal production on a substantial scale, and its gradual reinstatement as the area became politically and economically stable again at the beginning of the thirteenth century.

不过，要点在于，既不应高估，也不应低估战争的影响。七世纪，影响安纳托利亚城乡聚落格局、生产和人口的经济变化，许多是长期性的。战争只是应该考虑的若干因素之一，在有些地区，也许不起作用或作用极为有限。不过在其他地方，例如这里所说的卡帕多西亚地区，战争的影响似乎比别处严酷得多。例如，甘格拉（昌克勒）一带乔尔湖的花粉表明，约750年（上下浮动二十五年）人类活动的迹象骤然减少。有人认为，这可能反映了八世纪上半叶阿拉伯人的袭扰（史料提到了712年和727年的具体袭击），当然也可能有其他原因。
证据不足，很难准确估计战争对于人口的影响，但值得指出的是，难民迁徙以及政府从帝国境外迁入人口的事，在史料中非常突出。社会各阶层的难民从被征服的地区逃出家园，或放弃已被敌人蹂躏的土地。例如，早在650年代，就有来自亚美尼亚与奇里乞亚的修道团体定居在远至罗马和撒丁的地方，这暗示了范围更广的趋势。647年之后，另有一些修道士从遭萨拉森人攻击的北非行省逃到意大利，其中一些人原来来自巴勒斯坦。
其他人口群体也可能逃入安纳托利亚，特别是630年代后期以来来自叙利亚北部的许多人。
拜占庭在叙利亚和奇里乞亚边境的一些聚落遭到居民放弃，比如西锡翁。如刚才所说，欧凯塔的居民曾考虑放弃他们的城市。五六会议的教规也提到，敌袭导致居民抛下聚落和土地，教士也逃离了这样的地区。

But the main point of this is that the effects of warfare should be neither overestimated nor underestimated. Many of the economic changes that affected the patterns of urban and rural settlement, production, and population of Anatolia in the seventh century were of a longer-term character. Warfare was just one of several factors to be taken into account, and in some areas may have played no or only a very limited role. In others, though, such as this region of Cappadocia, its impact seems to have been much more severe than elsewhere. In the region of Gangra (Çankırı), for example, pollen from Lake Çöl show a sudden decrease in the evidence for anthropogenic activities ca. 750 (± twenty-five years). It has been suggested that this may reflect Arab raiding in the first half of the eighth century (specific attacks are mentioned in the sources for 712 and 727), among other potential causes.

The demographic impact of the warfare is difficult to judge exactly for want of evidence, but it is worth pointing out that movements of refugees and of groups transferred by the government from without the empire are prominent in our sources. Refugees of all social categories fled their homes in the conquered territories or abandoned lands that had been subject to enemy ravages. Already by the 650s communities of monks from Armenia and Cilicia had established themselves as far afield as Rome and Sardinia, for example, suggestive of a wider tendency, while other monks, some of them originally from Palestine, fled to Italy from Saracen attacks on the North African provinces after 647.
It is likely that other elements of the population fled to Anatolia, notably many from northern Syria from the late 630s onward.

Some Byzantine settlements along the Syrian and Cilician frontiers, such as Sision, were abandoned by their populations; the inhabitants of the city of Euchaïta, as we have just noted, considered abandoning their town; and the canons of the Quinisext themselves make reference to the abandonment of settlements and of the land as a result of hostile attacks, as well as to the flight of clergy from such areas.
分析出席680—681年与691—692年两次七世纪后期教会会议的主教代表的地区，就会发现，安纳托利亚西部和南部地区的代表，远不如北部和东部地区的多。有人认为，这反映了战争对这些地区的影响。650至670年代，从小亚细亚腹地向君士坦丁堡进攻的主要通道，正是这些地方。
难民的迁移和安置不可能罕见。五六会议第38条教规规定了什么条件下可以建新城或重建旧城。第39条举了一个实例，塞浦路斯君士坦提亚的居民由主教约翰率领迁徙，查士丁尼二世将他们安置在赫勒斯滂一带的新查士丁尼城（Nea Ioustinianoupolis）。第95条教规关于异端，指出难民中有好几种异端的信徒。
这些难民中有许多人可能是亚美尼亚人。形势所迫，他们分批在不同时候来到，有时人数多，有时人数少，通常由自己的领袖率领，原因是阿拉伯人施加的压力，不过许多时候他们很快又回到了故乡。有些肯定留下了。661年，有一些信奉“异端”的亚美尼亚保罗派，在本都的新凯撒里亚与尼科波利斯之间定居。后来卡帕多西亚的一些军事豪族，可以把自身的起源追溯到当地这类移民和定居活动。
除这少数例子外，难民具体去了哪里，一般并不清楚；不过塞浦路斯人的目的地，显然是安纳托利亚西北部。除难民外，君士坦斯二世（658年）和查士丁尼二世（688/689年）统治时，政府也把大批俘虏迁到小亚细亚，主要迁往比提尼亚或卡帕多西亚。这清楚表明，几乎持续不断的战争给土著人口造成了严重损失。负责安置这些人口的一些高官的铅印玺留存下来，可以看出这类迁移对政府何等重要。
然而，即便这些措施也未必能弥补损失。一部八世纪的叙利亚文编年史提到716年入侵军队经过时的情况：“亚细亚和卡帕多西亚各地……远至梅利泰内，再溯阿尔萨尼亚斯河，直抵内亚美尼亚……本有众多居民居住，满种葡萄、谷物以及各种结果的树，把土地装点得十分繁盛。但自此以后［这些地方］就荒废了……一直无人重新定居。”

An analysis of the regions represented by the bishops who were present at the late seventh-century church councils of 680–681 and 691–692 shows that the western and southern regions of Anatolia were far less well represented than those from the north and east, and it has been argued that this reflects the impact of the warfare on these areas, districts that formed the main corridor of attacks into Asia Minor and toward Constantinople in the 650s to 670s.

The movement and resettling of refugees cannot have been unusual: canon 38 of the Quinisext deals with the conditions under which new or refounded cities were to be established, and as an example canon 39 deals with the case of the transplanting of the Cypriots of Constantia under their bishop, John, who were established by Justinian II at Nea Ioustinianoupolis in the Hellespont. Canon 95 is concerned with heresy, and it names various heretics as being among the refugees.

At different times according to the exigencies of the moment, many of these may have been Armenians who came in both larger and smaller numbers, usually under their own leaders, and as a result of Arab pressure, although in many cases returned quite soon to their homeland. Some certainly stayed: in 661 a number of “heretical” Armenian Paulicians settled in the Pontic region between Neokaisareia and Nikopolis; some of the later military magnate families of Cappadocia could trace their origins to such migrations and settlements in that area.

Where exactly the refugees went is generally not known, apart from these few cases, but in the case of the Cypriots, northwest Anatolia was clearly the destination. In addition to refugees, the government also transplanted captive populations en masse to Asia Minor during the reigns of Constans II (in 658) and Justinian II (in 688/689), mostly to Bithynia or to Cappadocia, a clear indication of the damage inflicted by almost constant warfare on the indigenous populations. The lead seals of some of the high-ranking officials who dealt with these settlers survive to illustrate just how important such transfers were for the government.

Yet even such moves could not always undo the damage. An eighth-century Syriac chronicle notes of the transit of the invading armies in 716: “the regions of Asia and Cappadocia. . . as far as Melitene and by the river Arsanias as far as Inner Armenia. . . had been graced by the habitations of a numerous population and thickly planted with vineyards and grain and every kind of fruitful tree; but since that time (they have) been deserted and. . . have not been resettled.”
谷物与新的农业体系？
Grain and a New Agrarian Regime?

700年前后，帝国的政治局势不断恶化，再维持很久的希望似乎越来越渺茫。除了人口减少、区域性农业退缩和生产趋于简化，帝国许多地方还承受战争和不安定的影响，城市生活萎缩，国家据以征税和供养军队的农产也减少了。这使采购物资，尤其是为首都君士坦丁堡和驻各行省的军队供应谷物，显得特别重要。618年，埃及失陷于波斯人之手，641年起又彻底落入阿拉伯人手中，政府为此遭到沉重打击，因为埃及曾是帝国的粮仓。往年将尼罗河三角洲收获的谷物逐年运往爱琴海、再送到君士坦丁堡的大型运粮船队，不再航行。事实上，阿拉伯人在对君士坦丁堡实施消耗战的同时，也在进行经济战。君士坦丁堡政府取消了在都城向公众配给面包的办法，这一举措极不得人心，政府还须另找都城的谷物来源。
此外，自640和650年代起，野战军撤入安纳托利亚，各行省如今还得额外养活大量的人与牲畜。这件事虽很重要，却几乎没有人谈到。下面要讨论的正是帝国的粮源与各军队的供应问题。

As the political situation in the empire in the years around 700 worsened, so did the chances of its surviving for much longer seem ever more slender. As well as a demographic decline, a regional retreat of agriculture, and a simplification of agricultural production, it also had to deal with the impact of warfare and insecurity across many areas, a retrenchment of urban life, and a reduction in the agricultural products upon which the state based its taxation and supported its armies. This makes the issue of supplies, of grain in particular, for the capital, Constantinople, and for the armies in the provinces of especial importance. The loss of Egypt in 618 to the Persians, and then for good to the Arabs from 641, was a serious blow to the government because Egypt had been the bread-basket of the empire. The great grain fleets carrying the annual harvest from the Nile delta to the Aegean and on to Constantinople no longer operated; indeed, the Arabs waged economic warfare as much as they waged a war of attrition against Constantinople. The government at Constantinople, having discontinued the public bread dole in the capital, a deeply unpopular move, needed to find new sources of grain for the capital.

Not only that, but with the withdrawal of the field armies into Anatolia from the 640s and 650s onward, the provinces now had to supply substantial numbers of additional mouths, both human and animal. This consideration is rarely if ever discussed, important though it is, and it is the issue of the empire’s grain supply and of supplying the armies to which I now want to turn.
可能的谷物来源不多。研究显示，实际上只有四种选择切实可行。最初可能是北非，继而是西西里。同这两个地区有关的帝国财税官员
kommerkiarioi
的印玺，以及650至670年代两地与首都之间货物往来的陶器资料，都提示了这一点。

事实上，西西里的钱币和印玺证据表明，希拉克略治下、波斯人占领埃及时，西西里是君士坦丁堡政府一种重要而可贵的谷物来源。君士坦斯二世统治期间（即自650年代起），以及他的继任者统治时，也有一段时期是如此。但是，如利利也指出的，西西里离君士坦丁堡很远，660年代之后，很难保证每年定期安全送达。实际上，自650年代起，阿拉伯海上力量严重挑战罗马对海上通道的控制后，这一来源加倍成问题。君士坦斯二世于662年移往西西里，几乎肯定与西西里和北非的粮食供应有关。同样重要的是，西西里在约700年这样相对较早的时期，就有了
strategos
，即军队统帅，这表明帝国相当重视西西里。
例如，在印玺和文献里留下记录的八、九世纪西西里军队统帅，比帝国其他任何一个军区都多，表明此岛具有经济与军事战略上的价值。
自650年代起，阿非利加受到阿拉伯人从陆上袭掠的威胁。647年总督格里高利战败而死之后，北非各行省似乎有十年以上都在向东边的阿拉伯政权纳贡。值得注意的是，那些被认为与经管北非谷物有关的帝国官员的印玺，在647年格里高利篡位、战败前后消失，直到673—674年才再次出现，也就是在君士坦丁堡政府试图恢复对该地区的财政控制之后不久。
不管怎样，帝国在迦太基的最后一个前哨最终于692年丧失。第二种选择是色雷斯与巴尔干南部，但在七世纪后期和八世纪的大部分时间，它们无法提供定期而可靠的供应。七世纪头四分之三的时间里，生产很容易受到斯拉夫入侵者的袭掠与攻击而中断，之后又遭保加尔人袭扰。虽说后来政治和经济局势较稳时，都城有相当一部分谷物、蔬菜与肉类供应是来自这些地区。
第三种可能的来源是比提尼亚与小亚细亚西北部。那里确实产粮，而且据证据显示，当地产量有可能足以供养717—718年围攻结束后的君士坦丁堡驻军和留下的民众。八世纪后期及九世纪，比提尼亚的谷物无疑是重要的物产。

The possible sources of grain are not many. Studies have shown that there were, in effect, only four realistic options. At first North Africa, and then Sicily, may have served this purpose— the evidence of both the seals of imperial fiscal officials,
kommerkiarioi,
associated with both regions is suggestive, as is the ceramic data for the movement of goods between both provinces and the capital in the period from the 650s to 670s.

Indeed, the numismatic and sigillographic evidence from Sicily shows that it was an important and valuable source of grain for the Constantinople government during the reign of Heraclius, when the Persians were in occupation of Egypt, and again for a time during the reign of Constans II (so, from the 650s) as well as those of his successors. But as Lilie also noted, Sicily was a long way from Constantinople and could hardly guarantee a secure and regular annual delivery after the 660s. Indeed, from the 650s, with Arab sea power henceforth a serious challenge to Roman control of the sea-lanes, such a source of supply became doubly problematic, and Constans II’s move to Sicily in 662 was almost certainly connected with the grain supplies of Sicily and North Africa. Just as importantly, the appearance of a
strategos,
or generalissimo, for the island at a comparatively early date, ca. 700, suggests that Sicily figured fairly prominently in imperial priorities.

More military commanders are known from seals and texts for Sicily for the eighth and ninth centuries, for example, than for any other single military province of the empire, suggestive of the economic as much as of the military strategic value of the island.

Africa was endangered by Arab raids by land from the 650s, and with the defeat and death of the exarch Gregory in 647, the North African provinces appear to have lain under tribute to the Arab authorities to the east for over a decade. It is worth noting that the seals of imperial officials who have been associated with the management of North African grain disappear at about the time of Gregory’s usurpation and defeat in 647 and reappear only in 673–674, shortly after the government at Constantinople tried to reimpose fiscal control over the region.

In any case, its last outpost at Carthage was finally lost in 692. A second option lay in Thrace and the southern Balkan regions, but for much of the later seventh and eighth century they were in no position to provide a regular and reliable supply; production was easily disrupted by raids and attacks from Slavic invaders throughout the first three-quarters of the seventh century, and thereafter from the Bulgars, although at a later date—in a more stable political and economic situation— these regions provided a good part of the city’s supply in grains, vegetables, and meat.

A third possibility lay in Bithynia and the northwestern regions of Asia Minor. They certainly produced grain, and there is evidence to suggest that enough could be produced to supply the garrison and residual population of Constantinople after the siege of 717–718 was over. In the later eighth and ninth centuries grain from Bithynia was certainly a significant product.

我们知道七世纪中叶有运粮船从黑海南岸驶往赫尔松。
从整个八世纪直到九世纪的相当长时间，也有明确证据表明，阿马斯特里斯是黑海贸易的重要中心，尤其是对赫尔松的贸易。
七世纪后期或八世纪初，帝国官员负责黑海南岸若干地区和主要港口的仓库与粮仓，他们的铅印玺可以证明这层关系。

据十世纪的

This leaves the Pontic regions, Paphlagonia and Pontus, with the important ports of Trebizond, Amastris, Heraklea, and Sinope. Textual as well as limited archaeological evidence shows that these were comparatively flourishing across the seventh and eighth centuries.
We know that grain ships traveled from the southern Black Sea coast to Cherson in the middle years of the seventh century.
Throughout the eighth century and well into the ninth century there is clear evidence for Amastris as an important focus of Black Sea trade, especially to Cherson.

The evidence of lead seals of imperial officials in charge of store houses and granaries for several regions and major ports along the southern Black Sea coast, dating to the later seventh or early eighth century, illustrate the relationship.
And there was certainly a regular
annual grain traffic to Constantinople in the first half of the ninth century, conducted by contracted ship owners or
nauklēroi
, from particular regions such as the Aegean and Paphlagonia to Constantinople, and managed through the general
logothesion

. The emperor Nicephorus I introduced a series of measures intended to indemnify or insure the government in respect of the activities of such ship owners. Ships’ masters from the island of Androte, located off the Paphlagonian coast, who had defrauded the government of some of the grain they were to transport are mentioned in a letter written in the 820s.
According to the tenth-century
De administrando imperio

(“On governing the empire”), Cherson was supplied with grain by sea from the southern Black Sea coastal ports, just as it had been in the second half of the seventh century: “If grain does not pass across from Aminsos and from Paphlagonia and the Boukellarioi and the flanks of the Armeniakoi, the Chersonites cannot live.” Aminsos (Samsun), Paphlagonia, and the Boukellarion region as well as the Armeniakon are named, and there is no reason to doubt that such grain could also be shipped to the capital.

虽说有限的花粉数据表明，约700年之后，内陆帕夫拉戈尼亚与本都的一些地方总体上缩减了农业活动，但从广义上说，这些地区在七至九世纪乃至更晚，显然既能供应自己，也能供应帝国较远的地方。以欧凯塔一带为例，那里总体上并不特别适宜农业。古时候，这是法泽莫尼提斯地区的南部，毗邻迪亚科佩内。斯特拉波说这里“大体上没有树木，却生产谷物”。十一世纪的主教约翰·毛罗普斯也在一封信中形容该地区“十分荒凉，无人居住，环境恶劣，没有树木、植被、树林或阴处，彻底是一片荒无人理的旷野……然而，谷物的产出十分丰盛”。
七至八世纪较为湿润的条件，当然不会对这种农业方式产生不利影响。

While the limited palynological data suggest a reduction in agricultural activity in general after ca. 700 in some parts of inland Paphlagonia-Pontus, it is clear that these regions in their widest sense could supply both themselves and more distant parts of the empire in the period from the seventh to the ninth century and beyond. Consider, for example, the case of the region around Euchaïta, on the whole not a particularly favored agrarian environment. In ancient times this was the southerly portion of the district of Phazemonitis, running alongside the region of Diakopene. It was described by Strabo as “in general bare of trees and productive of grain.” In one of his letters the eleventh-century bishop John Mauropous also describes the region as “very desolate, uninhabited, unpleasant and without trees, vegetation, woods or shade, a total wilderness full of neglect. . . It abounds, however, in the production of grain.”
The wetter conditions of the seventh to eighth centuries would certainly not have impacted negatively on this regime.
还应指出，农业活动的衰退或许也意味着人口减少，而与此同时，它可能掩盖了相对于总人口而言的产量增长。在这一时期的情形下，这种潜在增长，很可能对土地所能供养的人口有重要影响。此外，政府与
nauklēroi
签订承运合同，也清楚表明国家继续直接关心谷物的来源与运往何地。上述信件是代船长们写给总务财政官德莫卡里斯的，请求宽大处理。一点格外重要的是，此事与国库（
dēmosios logos
）每年的谷物运输有关。早期的总
kommerkiarioi
由这个部门管辖，九世纪初，也是该部门管理帝国的
kommerkia
，即仓库或粮仓。

It should also be remarked that while a decline in agrarian activity probably indicates also a demographic decline, it may at the same time disguise an increase in production relative to total population. In the conditions of the period in question, such a potential increase may well have had significant consequences in respect of the carrying capacity of the landscape. In addition, the presence of
nauklēroi

contracted by the government shows quite clearly that the state continued to have a direct interest in the sources and delivery destinations for grain. The letter in question was written on behalf of the ships’ captains to Democharis, the general logothete, to beg for leniency. Particularly important is the fact that this concerns the annual shipment for the public treasury (
dēmosios logos
), the department under whose remit the earlier general
kommerkiarioi
had fallen, and which in the early ninth century administered the imperial
kommerkia
, the warehouses or granaries.

此处不妨简要考察生产技术，以及谷物等作物的播种量与收获量之比。早期拜占庭方面的具体材料并不多，不过稍早一些的证据、十世纪以来的证据，以及罗马世界其他地区类似情形的证据，确实使我们可以得出一些概括性的结论。拜占庭农业始终以农民家庭户为基本单位。家庭通常是村社的组成部分，村社又是核定税赋与组织社会生活的基础。耕种土地的数量、种植作物的种类，因地区、地形、家庭大小、相对贫富程度及类似因素而异。大多数农户有菜园，生产家庭所必需的蔬菜，不过大庄园上虽受雇却仅享有部分自由的劳动者，其生计更多依赖于地主（关于各种佃户各占多大比例，证据稀少，连最笼统的估计也做不出来）。除少数例外，多数农户看来都采取混合耕作，即便以谷物为主的地方也是如此。有些豆类在生产周期和作物、田地轮作制度中十分重要。同样，除社会与经济地位最低的人以外，多数农户也养有一些牲畜，不过数量差别同样很大。

It might be appropriate at this point to consider briefly production techniques and matters relating to the yield on seed sown for cereals, among other crops. This is a subject about which we do not have a great deal of specific information from the early Byzantine period, but evidence from somewhat earlier as well as from the tenth century and later, and evidence from comparable situations in other parts of the Roman world does permit some general conclusions. Byzantine agriculture was organized throughout on the basis of the peasant family household, normally forming one element in a village community that served as the basis for both fiscal assessments as well as social life. The amount of land farmed and the types of crops produced varied by region, terrain, size of family, relative degrees of wealth and poverty, and similar factors. Most peasant households possessed a garden that produced essential vegetables for the family, although the semi-free waged workers on large estates were more dependent on their landlords for their sustenance (and the evidence is too slender to hazard even the most general estimates of the proportion of different types of tenant one to another). With few exceptions it would appear that most farming was mixed, even where cereals dominated, with some legumes being an important element of the productive cycle and the system of crop and field rotation; and, again with the exception of those of the lowest social and economic status, most households had some livestock, although again numbers varied considerably.

产量，即收成的多少，当然很难估计。根据有限的证据，学者对古代和拜占庭后期小麦的种收比提出了一些解释和估计。有一类估计认为，在最贫瘠的土地上或收成不好时，种收比为1∶3，平均可能为1∶4或1∶5，条件特别有利时偶尔能达到1∶8或1∶9。另一端的估计则提出1∶9甚至1∶15。这取决于具体地区、所据文献，以及研究者是否愿意从稀少的数据推论一般情况。十一、十二世纪巴尔干的拜占庭农业相当集约，每平方米播种约三百粒（依照
《农事集成》
，当时的地主确实读过这部书）。这种条件是否适用于七、八世纪的安纳托利亚，无从得知。但种收比如果低于1∶4，肯定几乎产生不了可出售的剩余。
内盖夫的内萨纳档案中，有一份七世纪中叶有关当地灌溉田地的纸草文书，记载小麦的种收比为1∶7，大麦则更高，达1∶8或1∶9。这表明，农业环境较不优越的地方也能取得这样的收成。
既然帕夫拉戈尼亚与本都的谷物收成显然确有可供外销的剩余，就必然可以得出结论，它们的种收比至少达到这一水平，多数年份可能还要高得多。

Production levels— the size of harvests— are, of course, very difficult to assess, and on the basis of the limited evidence, some interpretations and proposals about returns on seed for wheat in both the ancient and the later Byzantine periods have been made. Thus, at one extreme the rate fluctuates between 1:3 on the poorest land or in a bad season to an average of perhaps 1:4 or 1:5 and, occasionally, in especially favorable circumstances, to as much as 1:8 or 1:9. At the other end of the scale, outputs between 1:9 or even 1:15 have been suggested, depending on area, the textual source in question, and the willingness or not of historians to generalize from sparse data. Byzantine farming in the Balkans in the eleventh and twelfth centuries was fairly intensive, with a sowing of some three hundred grains per square meter (following the
Geoponika

, which were certainly read by landlords at that period); whether such conditions applied in Anatolia in the seventh and eighth centuries is impossible to say, but it is certainly the case that a return of less than 1:4 would barely generate a marketable surplus.

A papyrus document from the Nessana archive in the Negev, dating to the middle of the seventh century and relating to irrigated fields in the area, records returns of 1:7 for wheat and an even higher rate of 1:8 or 1:9 for barley, showing what sort of return could be managed from a less favorable agrarian environment.

Since it is evident that cereal harvests from Paphlagonia and Pontus did indeed generate such a surplus, the conclusion is unavoidable that returns on seed sown were at least as high as this and in most years may have been considerably higher.
十、十一世纪的税务文书与财税官员用的手册，确有一些数字，让我们对帝国各地的相对生产水平略有所知。例如，小亚细亚西部和西南部的耕地，被认为比色雷斯与马其顿相当的耕地多产约19%，比其中部与东部地区的土地多产约30%。
值得注意的是，材料并未专门提到本都与帕夫拉戈尼亚。不过，它们一向比内陆地区稍肥沃，也更适宜集约耕种，因此可以假定，它们的生产能力至少同前述欧洲诸行省相当。我们仍没有七、八世纪的可比资料，不过在其间的年代里，这些差异大概不会有太大的改变，因而多少能说明，即使在艰难时期，拜占庭农业也具备了怎样的相对与潜在的富裕程度。

We do have some figures from tax documents and from handbooks for fiscal officials from the tenth and eleventh centuries that tell us a little about relative levels of production in different parts of the empire. Thus, arable land in western and southwestern Asia Minor was considered more productive by an order of some 19 percent than equivalent land in Thrace and Macedonia, and by an order of some 30 percent than land in the central and eastern regions.

Interestingly, the Pontic region and Paphlagonia are not mentioned specifically, but since they were certainly at all times somewhat more fertile and suited to intensive farming than the inland regions, we might assume that they had at least the same productive capacity as the European provinces mentioned. While again we have no comparable information for the seventh and eighth centuries, such differences are unlikely to have changed a great deal in the intervening period and thus give some idea of the relative and potential wealth of Byzantine agriculture even in difficult times.
